verdict.rationale: The Server Administration Guide documents an official Admin CLI (kcadm.sh) shipped in the server distribution's bin directory, which supports scripted administration of realms, users, roles, and clients, with the same operations available over the Admin REST API. The getting-started docs also show the server launched from the command line (start-dev). Missing for 10: AI- or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output or non-interactive auth guidance), in-depth CLI reference evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
